# Energy JobSearch

> > Energy JobSearch is a specialized job board and recruitment platform connecting talent with 30,000+ positions across the global energy, oil & gas sector.

Energy JobSearch aggregates job listings from major energy employers and staffing agencies worldwide, while also offering recruitment services including CV databases, job posting tools, and employer branding solutions for energy sector companies.

## Key Topics

- Energy sector jobs
- Oil & gas industry
- Engineering positions
- Global recruitment
- Project management
- Technical roles
- Oilfield jobs
- Full-time employment
- Talent acquisition
- Job vacancies
- Qatar Energy
- KBR
- Intertek
- NES Fircroft
- Employer of record (EOR)

## Job Search & Browsing

- [Jobs in the Energy industry](https://energyjobsearch.com/jobs): Browse 30,782+ energy industry jobs across all sectors and roles
- [Jobs per category](https://energyjobsearch.com/sitedirectory/title-jobs): Energy job categories directory for browsing positions by role type
- [101 available companies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies): Directory of 101 energy sector employers and recruitment agencies

- [Qatar Energy job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/qatar-energy): Qatar Energy oil & gas job opportunities in Doha and region
- [KBR job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/kbr): KBR engineering and technical roles in energy sector worldwide

- [SPIE Global Services Energy job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/spie-global-services-energy): Job vacancies at SPIE Global Services Energy in energy sector roles
- [NES Fircroft job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/nes-fircroft): NES Fircroft staffing and engineering positions in energy sector
- [Hill International job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/hill-international): Hill International project management and construction engineering jobs
- [Global Project Services AG job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/global-project-services-ag): Job listings for Global Project Services AG across multiple global locations
- [RCG Moody International Limited c/- Intertek job vacancies](https://energyjobsearch.com/companies/rcg-moody-international-limited-c-intertek): Intertek petroleum testing and technician positions globally

- [EOR, Staffing & Recruitment Services For Energy, Oil & Gas Companies](http://hiring.energyjobsearch.com/Services/international-eor-recruitment-services): Employer of record and RPO recruitment services for energy companies
